# GitHub Account Age Checker

> A free browser-based tool for checking the creation date and elapsed age of a public GitHub account.

Enter a GitHub username or profile URL in the checker to view the account's public creation date and a live elapsed-age counter. The lookup uses the GitHub API; results depend on GitHub's data, service availability, and rate limits.

## Pages

- [GitHub Account Age Checker](https://gh-age.pages.dev/): Check a public profile's creation date and account age.
